title: Music in Biloxi and Willie's trips there
summary: Little music in Biloxi when she was young; Willie went there to play parades before knowing her, and her sister cooked for the band.

story.theme_name: Brass bands, parades and jazz funerals
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Yeah, I remember that part. Did they have much music in Biloxi when you were young?

When I was young? Not nothing much. I used to go there and play what you're talking about. I played big parades. Yeah. With the old fellows. You know, the paint rocks and all them. You know, he used to go all over there with them.
Did he go there before you knew him? Did he say that?
Oh, yeah. He had been going over there before he knew me.
My sister got acquainted with him, you see, after he was married to me. My sister used to fix the dinner for him when they come over there, fix their dinners for all of them. Mm-hmm. Yeah.
